goal: JWT review: algorithm choice, signature checks, expiry and claims that are trusted too much.
use: JWT review: algorithm choice, signature checks, expiry and claims that are trusted too much. Use when code creates or validates JSON web tokens.

steps.note: Check the algorithm. Flag 'none', symmetric keys shared with clients, or an algorithm chosen from the token header.
Check signatures. Every token must be verified before its claims are used.
Check expiry and audience. Tokens need short lifetimes and an audience check.
Check claims. Flag authorisation decided from claims the client can set.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
